meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 10.1 External Brand Consistency, Truth & Campaign QA

production_rules: Every external asset must preserve the locked Time Trace identity, semantic palette, typography hierarchy and recognizable Dấu Việt composition; campaign expression cannot create a parallel brand.
Social crops at 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 and 16:9 must preserve the focal subject, essential disclosure and platform-safe text/logo zones.
App Store and Google Play creative must show real product states and truthful capabilities; fabricated UI, fake ratings/reviews, fake community activity and impossible product states are prohibited.
Historical, archive, reconstruction, AI-generated and materially restored media retain Phase 07 classification/disclosure after crop, thumbnailing, animation and video export.
External imagery must resolve to the correct place/person/event/entity; visually similar or higher-performing wrong-entity substitutes are prohibited.
Campaign copy cannot turn uncertain or disputed historical claims into certainty, nor use unsupported oldest/first/biggest/superlative claims.
Localized assets preserve meaning, disclosure and brand hierarchy; copy remains editable and is recomposed for locale rather than mechanically baked into one raster master.
Video and motion marketing follow Phase 06, include captions/subtitles for informational speech, and preserve disclosure long enough to be perceivable.
Co-branding keeps marks separate, preserves Time Trace geometry/clearspace/contrast, and never implies editorial endorsement or verification that does not exist.
Press/media kits distribute approved master assets, usage rules and rights/provenance context; screenshots or recreated logos are not substitutes for official assets.
Marketing optimization cannot use fake social proof, fabricated urgency, dark-pattern CTAs, misleading before/after comparisons or inaccessible click-maximizing treatments.
Every campaign asset must communicate one primary story/question and a truthful next action; generic travel collage, logo wallpaper and decorative pseudo-history are prohibited defaults.
